tasks.title: Revision pagination resurrects deleted records and repeats page boundaries
tasks.intro: An activity browser reads a stream containing multiple revisions per record. The page builder must pick the latest revision before sorting and applying a stable cursor. Repairs must coordinate duplicate resolution, deletion handling and page metadata so users do not see stale or repeated rows.

  True
)
